verdict.rationale: Sardine documents initial and ongoing daily OFAC sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, with alerts when customers appear on lists and tunable fuzzy-match thresholds. Company coverage comes through UBO screening that combines KYB with KYC/AML, OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership logic, and inline screening of payment senders and receivers. missing for 10: evidence that users can select or configure which sanctions/watchlists are screened, an enumerated list catalogue beyond OFAC/PEP/adverse media, explicit standalone company-name screening, independent or hands-on corroboration.
